name: Repatriation visa (wiza krajowa w celu repatriacji)

requirement_groups.name: Polish descent, historic residence in designated former-USSR territories

requirements.blocker_text: Requires that the applicant lived permanently, before 1 January 2001, in the territory of present-day Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, or the Asian part of the Russian Federation.
Requires that at least one parent, grandparent, or two great-grandparents confirmed their belonging to the Polish Nation (e.g. through cultivation of Polish culture, language, or traditions).

The consul requires proof of housing and a source of income in Poland for at least 12 months (e.g. a lease and a 12-month job offer or self-employment declaration), or a confirmed place in a government adaptation centre for repatriates.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a 12-month lease and job offer in Poland, or apply for a place in a repatriate adaptation centre through the local commune/gmina.

evidence_required.document: Consular decision confirming Polish origin (stwierdzenie polskiego pochodzenia)
Proof of pre-2001 permanent residence in a designated territory
Lease/housing proof plus a 12-month employment offer or self-employment declaration, or an adaptation-centre placement decision

outcome.duration_length: visa valid 12 months to enter Poland; citizenship is instant on entry
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: citizenship is acquired automatically by operation of law on the day the visa holder crosses the Polish border, not on any later date

sources.title: gov.pl (Ministerstwo Spraw Wewnętrznych i Administracji) -- Kto może ubiegać się o repatriację
MSWiA archive -- Procedura repatriacyjna, corroborating the 12-month visa validity and the housing/income proof requirements

Lubuski Urząd Wojewódzki (regional government office, BIP public-information portal) -- Repatriacja, corroborating the spouse's permanent-residence provision and the 'uznanie za repatrianta' domestic route

notes: STRUCTURAL OUTLIER, the only route found across all 15 countries in this build (214 routes total) where citizenship is acquired instantly and automatically -- 'z mocy prawa z dniem przekroczenia granicy Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej' (by operation of law on the day of crossing the Polish border) -- rather than after any residence period at all, confirmed identically across powroty.gov.pl and multiple gov.pl embassy pages (China, UAE, South Africa). citizenship_after_months is correctly 0, not null or a placeholder: there is no waiting period whatsoever once the visa is used to enter. This is categorically faster even than pl_karta_polaka's zero-wait permanent-residence track, since repatriation skips permanent residence entirely and grants citizenship directly. The geographic restriction is the genuinely unusual hard requirement: eligibility is scoped to specific former-USSR successor states (plus 'the Asian part of the Russian Federation' specifically, excluding European Russia) reflecting the historical deportations of Poles under 1936-1950s Soviet policy -- a person of identical Polish ancestry who instead grew up in, say, Lithuania or Belarus does not qualify for repatriation and must use pl_karta_polaka or a standard route instead. current_location is used here as a proxy for 'historic pre-2001 permanent residence location,' which is an imperfect fit against the schema's ~26-attribute closed list -- flagged honestly rather than inventing a new attribute, consistent with the project's requirement-grammar discipline; a cleaner long-term fix would be a dedicated historic-residence attribute, noted here as a candidate schema addition rather than added unilaterally. switchable_to is empty by design: this route terminates directly in citizenship, so there is nothing further to switch to.
